name: DeltaPrime Avalanche unvalidated LFJ reward pair
summary: TraderJoeV2AvalancheFacet.claimReward(address,uint256[]) accepts an arbitrary LFJ pair address without checking that the LFJ factory created it, then trusts that pair's hook and rewarder. It snapshots the Prime Account's WAVAX balance, calls the caller-supplied pair's claim(), and pays out the difference to msg.sender with no solvency check. The malicious rewarder calls back into the Prime Account's wrapped-native facet to wrap borrowed native AVAX between the before and after snapshots, so pool debt drawn through swapDebtParaSwap is reclassified as reward and transferred out.
notes: DiamondCut on SmartLoanDiamondBeacon 0x2916b3bf7c35bd21e63d01c93c62fb0d4994e56d replaced the route for selector 0xb2af870a (claimReward(address,uint256[])) with TraderJoeV2AvalancheFacet 0x2fcd23e6104a55132a81710382aa16ddbd3b58f2, the defect-bearing artifact, alongside 0x2001ff29 and 0x08a766eb. This is the last of seven pre-exploit cuts touching that selector out of 161 DiamondCut events on the beacon, and beacon.implementation(0xb2af870a) still returns that facet at block 52927410. The beacon is shared by every DeltaPrime Prime Account, so the defect was live for all of them from this cut onward; the attacker's own Prime Account 0xa9b975c11f6afce142799cebb80f078f1be4c8f6 was merely instantiated against the already-defective route eight seconds before the exploit and does not reset the artifact age.

Components are the exact depletion of DeltaPrime's Avalanche lending pools, summed from the Transfer logs of the six exploit transactions and the loot sweep: WavaxPool 0xd26e504fc642b96751fd55d3e68af295806542f5 -74420.190026835772433671 WAVAX, UsdcPool 0x2323dac85c6ab9bd6a8b5fb75b0581e31232d12b -860088.776389 USDC, BtcPool 0x475589b0ed87591a893df42ec6076d2499bb63d0 -6.34401755 BTC.b, UsdtPool 0xd222e10d7fe6b7f9608f14a8b5cf703c74efbca1 -259926.541496 USDt and WethPool 0xd7feb276ba254cd9b34804a986ce9a8c3e359148 -49.675622190954455477 WETH.e. The attacker's loot address 0xd3d535141831f6bd8b7df92e2ae0463d60af2413 holds 74183.842277799231529158 WAVAX, 860088.776389 USDC, 6.34401755 BTC.b, 259926.541496 USDt and 49.675622190954455477 WETH.e after the sweep, plus 110 native AVAX; a further 110 native AVAX went to the generalised front-runner 0x5135b55b35822d4d4df66deaf52edef613112c8e that landed the sweep, and per methodology that builder-style payment is not deducted. The 220 native AVAX are already inside the WAVAX quantity that left the pool and are not listed separately. All Balancer flash loans are repaid within their transactions and are not loss. This record covers the Avalanche leg only; the Arbitrum leg of the same campaign is the separate incident eip155:42161:0x6a2f989b5493b52ffc078d0a59a3bf9727d134b403aa6e0bf309fd513a728f7f, whose loss is now an independent onchain reconstruction of about 754 thousand USD from its own five Arbitrum pools, so the two records are disjoint and may be summed. CertiK measured about 4.1 million USD on Avalanche and about 753 thousand USD on Arbitrum against DeltaPrime's rounded 4.75 million USD campaign total.
